content:
priya: Quick heads up — EBR dry run 3pm PT today. Final slide pass + exec asks. Need owners for the final 4 slides and any open risk notes.
liam: On it. I'll take 'Onboarding health' slide.
ava: I'll cover 'Technical enablement + integration blockers'. Will add two bullets.
marco: Can do 'Renewal risk & next steps' — will pull MRR churn data.
sam_exec: I'll join the dry run; please put the 10-min exec summary at top. @priya can you confirm ask?
reminders-bot: Reminder: EBR dry run scheduled at 2025-11-12 15:00 PT — join link https://meet.redwood/ebr-dryrun
priya: Thanks. Final asks: 1) slide owners confirmed, 2) two-sentence ask for execs, 3) 1 backup demo clip. Please update this doc: https://docs.redwood/ebr/123
liam: Ask for execs: 'Approve 90-day pilot + dedicated capacity 2nd cohort' — will add.
ava: Demo clip — I'll record a 45s walkthrough of fast onboarding flow, uploading to the doc by 2:30pm.
marco: Pulling churn numbers now — small note: 3 accounts flagged as 50% renewal risk, details in spreadsheet.
priya: putting a tiny runbook here:
```
- 2:00pm slide dry pass
- 2:20pm run presenter notes & timing
- 2:40pm final deck export -> pdf
- 2:50pm exec pre-brief (sam)
- 3:00pm dry run
```
liam: Updated slide and notes. @ava can you sanity-check the integration blockers wording?
ava: checked, reworded to be less technical, added mitigation timeline 30/60/90.
marco: uploaded renewal flags and suggested POC outreach owners: @liam, @nora_cs
priya: perfect. small ask — everyone drop a two-line 'ask' in the doc by 2:15pm.
sam_exec: Read the asks — I trimmed to clear CTAs. Will push for dedicated capacity approval if engineering cost estimate < $X.
liam: :thumbsup: done.
ava: uploaded demo clip, link in doc.
priya: thanks team. after dry run, pls add final action items in this thread. I'll compile.

priya: Post-dry run notes — exec asked for more detail on cost delta and fallback model. Marco is owner for cost follow-up. Liam will own outreach plan for the 3 flagged accounts. Ava to schedule a brief with infra for fallback model options.
marco: Confirmed. I'll have cost delta slide by EOD Friday.
liam: I'll email the three champions today and loop CS ops.
ava: Booked a 30m with infra for Thurs 10am PT. Invite sent.
priya: Action items consolidated:
```
- Marco: cost delta slide + appendix (due Fri EOD)
- Liam: outreach emails + champions call (due Tue EOD)
- Ava: infra fallback options + notes (due Thu EOD)
- Priya: finalize exec readout deck + send to Sam (due Sat 11am)
```
sam_exec: Looks good. Make sure to include short one-pager for execs.
priya: will do. thanks all :pray:
